messages:
maria: quick sync — preparing the "stitch" rollforward for api v2 compatibility rollout. plan is: canary in us-central -> monitor -> staggered global burst. owners currently: @jamal (client SDKs), @oliver (edge/proxy), @sophie (qa/metrics). pls ack and call out blockers. runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/v2-rollforward

jamal: ack. i'm checking the SDK minor bump (v1.4.8 -> v1.5.0) and the deprecation warning cadence. question: do we keep the old header X-RI-Compat for 30d or 90d? my vote: 60d. also will open PR to add opt-in warning in the debug logs.

oliver: ack from proxy side. we plan to ship a lightweight shim that accepts old client payloads and rewrites to v2 until final cutoff. need a 1hr maintenance window to rotate the routing certs when we flip the canary weights. command to run on infra side: ```bash
./infra/bin/rotate-proxy --cluster us-central --cert=stitch-2026-03
```

sophie: ack. i'll queue the prompt-set evals against the canary this afternoon. can someone drop the top 10 customer prompts we should monitor? i'll run both quality regressions and token-cost delta. telemetry queries i'll use: ```sql
-- top errors by model
select model, count(1) as errors from requests where timestamp > now() - interval '6 hours' and status != '200' group by model order by errors desc limit 10;
```

leo: release notes / scheduling: reserved slot tomorrow 03:00 UTC for the canary roll (slot id: RS-1129). need final ack by EOD. canary thresholds: latency p95 < 150ms, error rate < 0.5% relative to baseline. if any threshold breached -> automatic rollback.

anna: i updated the ownership matrix and added PR owners column: https://redwood-internal/ownership/matrix#v2-rollforward. maria, i assigned you as escalation contact. pls confirm if that's okay. also requesting the PR numbers for the shim and SDK bump so SRE can pin monitors.

jamal: opened SDK PR -> https://git.redwood/sdks/clients/pulls/442 (adds warning header + feature flag). i'll add migration notes and a snippet for devs. example snippet to check header: ```js
if (resp.headers['x-ri-compat']) { console.warn('using legacy compat header'); }
```

oliver: proxy PR -> https://git.redwood/proxy/pulls/98 (shim + routing toggle). note: toggle defaults to off; we'll enable per-cluster. i'll add the cert rotation job in the deploy pipeline.

deploy-bot: canary smoke preflight: 3/4 checks passed (auth, routing, basic-liveness). perf-check pending. see CI: https://ci.redwood/runs/2201.

sophie: added the prompt deck in the runbook and queued the quality evals. will post results here once the canary runs (expect ~30–45m after canary start). also flagged two prompts that are sensitive to tokenization changes — leaning to keep them as must-monitor.

maria: thanks all. quick asks before EOD: (1) jamal/oliver drop PR numbers in the ownership matrix, (2) leo confirm alarm thresholds in PagerDuty policy, (3) sophie post eval baseline so we have % delta. if anyone expects > 0.8% user-facing regression please call it out now — we will hold. otherwise i'll flip the canary at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:

leo: confirmed PD alarms updated (PD policy id: PD-767).

jamal: added PR 442 to the matrix.

oliver: added PR 98 and scheduled cert rotation job in pipeline.

sophie: eval baseline posted: https://redwood-internal/evals/v2-canary/baseline-3065. will update with canary run results.

maria: perfect. closing the loop — i'll start the canary at 03:00 UTC unless an objection surfaces here. leave a note on the PR if you want a pause.

jamal: no objections from SDK side.

oliver: no objections.

sophie: no objections. rolling forward. good luck :rocket:
